title: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: Suppose your university student union is planning to hold a speech contest. You are now to write a proposal for organizing the contest. The proposal may include the topic, aim , procedure and selection of contestants. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: A Proposal for a Speech Contest On behalf of the Student Union, I am writing to propose that our university hold a campus speech contest next month, and the details are outlined below for your approval. The contest will focus on the theme "My Chinese Dream." Our aim is to sharpen students' public-speaking skills, build their confidence, and enrich campus cultural life. As for the procedure, we will first post a notice to call for entries. Then a preliminary round will be held in each college. Finally, twelve finalists will deliver their speeches on stage, scored by a panel of teachers and students. The selection of contestants will be fair and open: applicants must submit a written draft, and those with clear ideas and fluent expression will be shortlisted through a short interview. We sincerely hope you will approve this proposal, and any suggestions would be warmly welcomed. The Student Union
keyPoints: 标题＋首句表来意。标题 A Proposal for a Speech Contest 一眼点题；首句 On behalf of the Student Union, I am writing to propose that... 落实了「首句报身份表来意」，并用 outlined below for your approval 预告下文、点明请批目的。
主题＋目的两要点。The contest will focus on the theme "My Chinese Dream." 先定主 题；Our aim is to sharpen... build... and enrich... 用并列结构一次说清三个办赛目的，落实「先定主题 再讲意义」。
序数词分步写流程。As for the procedure 总起，first... Then... Finally... 把报名、初赛、决 赛三步依次串起，条理清晰，落实「序数词串起流程」。

补选拔＋礼貌收尾。The selection of contestants will be fair and open 单独交代最易漏的 选拔要点；结尾 We sincerely hope you will approve... and any suggestions would be warmly welcomed 请批并欢迎反馈，末署 The Student Union，落实「补齐选拔再礼貌收尾」。
